baseline_red_status_semantics: RED identifies reproducible findings at baseline_git_head; it is not the current unresolved status of the package.
scope_note_zh: 本记录是投稿方对最新 canonical main 的编辑、出版、权利与交接审查，不是公众反馈、专家意见、现场观察、审批结论或评审结果。
scope_note_en: This is the contributor's editorial, publication, rights and handoff audit of the latest canonical main. It is not public feedback, expert opinion, field observation, approval or a jury result.

repair_matrix.finding_zh: manifest 同时声明 formal-review-ready 与 not_fully_cleared、public_or_professional_reuse=blocked，评审入口与真实发布边界互相冲突。
repair_matrix.finding_en: The manifest simultaneously claims formal-review-ready while rights remain not_fully_cleared and public/professional reuse is blocked.
repair_matrix.target: 采用获授权的 CC BY 4.0 / MIT 双许可证边界，单列 ODbL 与第三方例外，并让 readiness 只陈述确定性校验状态。
repair_matrix.resolution_zh: 当前精确投稿包 167/167 路径已有组件级处置，可用于仓库评审、展示与再分发；独立法律/商标审查以及未来装置、品牌和专业实施继续单列为未授权。
repair_matrix.resolution_en: All 167/167 paths in the current exact package have component-level decisions for repository review, display and redistribution; independent legal/trademark review and future installation, branding and professional implementation remain separately unauthorized.

repair_matrix.finding_zh: 9 个可选生成媒体路径增加真实性与许可负担，却不是理解双轨空间裁决、三处原型或 G0 交接所必需。
repair_matrix.finding_en: Nine optional generated-media paths add authenticity and licensing burden without being necessary to understand the spatial ruling, the three prototypes or the G0 handoff.
repair_matrix.target: 清退非必要生成媒体，以可复现的原创图解、静态回退和默认封面替代。

repair_matrix.finding_zh: 正文、visual、报告、图件与图纸之间的入口过多，主张—证据—权利—专业交接仍需跨越多个重复表面。
repair_matrix.finding_en: Proposal, visual, report, figures and drawings expose too many competing entrances; claim-to-evidence-to-rights-to-handoff tracing still crosses repeated surfaces.
repair_matrix.target: 统一为 30 秒空间裁决、3 分钟四态与三处差异、15 分钟证据和专业交接三层阅读。

repair_matrix.finding_zh: 现有 8 项更新项目与 12 个场景均保持 G0，但缺少一个足够聚焦、可供专业团队继续核验的首要移交对象。
repair_matrix.finding_en: All eight projects and twelve scenarios correctly remain at G0, but there is no single focused object for a professional team to verify next.
repair_matrix.target: 仅将 JZ-05 × SCENE-011 × T-02 标为 pre-G1 专业移交候选；不升级成熟度、不承诺现场实施。
